title: Best Monitor Deals (Black Friday 2026)
summary: 5 monitors worth buying in the Black Friday sale, why each one is worth it, and the October 2026 prices to beat.
intro: 🔥 {deal_hook} on top monitors, but only while the offer lasts.

We picked 5 monitors for different needs: a cheap 4K screen, an all-rounder, a MacBook-friendly USB-C display, and two gaming deals. Prices can jump back or sell out at any time, so grab yours before it is gone.
method: Picks and prices come from AppleInsider's Oct 6, 2026 Prime Big Deal Days monitor roundup and PC Gamer's gaming monitor deals page, updated Oct 14, 2026. Each price is what those outlets reported at the retailer named. Prices change often and some Amazon deals were Prime-only, so treat each one as a price to beat, not a promise. The Amazon buttons open the product or search for the model, so check the exact model before you buy.
assumptions: no price is guaranteed on Black Friday itself. We will update this guide when real Black Friday deals go live.

products.name: Samsung ViewFinity S7 S71H
why: The ViewFinity S7 is the lowest price in AppleInsider's group of five 4K monitors, at 32% off its list price. You get a 27-inch 4K IPS panel for well under $200, which is a sharper picture than most 1080p monitors at this price.
The trade-offs are small. It runs at 60Hz and the stand does not adjust for height, so it suits a basic desk setup for work, browsing and streaming rather than fast games.
specs: HDR10 support, Samsung says it shows over 1 billion colors
HDMI and DisplayPort inputs, headphone jack
Eye Saver Mode reduces blue light and flicker
pros: Eye Saver Mode for long sessions
cons: Stand does not adjust for height
products.best_for: Anyone who wants a sharp 4K screen for work, browsing and streaming on the smallest budget.
products.skip_if: you want a high refresh rate for gaming, or a stand you can raise and lower.
products.deal_note: AppleInsider lists this as a Prime-exclusive offer on Oct 6, so the price may be higher if you are not a Prime member. Check the live price before you buy.

products.name: Dell S2725QS
why: The Dell S2725QS is the only 4K monitor in AppleInsider's group that reaches 120Hz, which is twice the refresh rate of the Samsung and KTC models. That makes scrolling and moving windows feel smoother, and it also helps in games.

It also has the most flexible stand of the cheaper picks, with height, swivel and pivot adjustment, plus built-in speakers. For about $60 more than the Samsung, you get a monitor that is easier to set up well.
specs: Height, swivel and pivot stand, built-in speakers
cons: 350 nits is modest brightness on paper
Costs about $59 more than the cheapest 4K pick
products.best_for: One monitor for work, streaming and some gaming without paying for a premium model.
products.skip_if: you only need basic office use, or you want USB-C charging from a laptop.
products.deal_note: It is $70 below its $299.99 list price in the Oct 6 Prime sale. Make sure you are looking at the S2725QS, since Dell sells several similar model numbers.

products.name: LG 27UP850K-W
why: The LG 27UP850K-W stands out for connectivity. It has a USB-C port that carries video and up to 90W of power, so a compatible laptop can show on the screen and charge over one cable. AppleInsider calls it the strongest laptop connection in the group.
It also covers up to 95% of the DCI-P3 color gamut and supports DisplayHDR 400. It has two USB 3.0 ports and speakers too, so it works as a small docking hub for a desk.
specs: USB-C with up to 90W power delivery
DisplayPort, two HDMI ports, two USB 3.0 ports, headphone jack
Height, tilt and pivot stand, built-in stereo speakers
cons: Costs the most of the 4K picks here
products.best_for: MacBook and laptop users who want one cable for video, power and USB devices.
products.skip_if: you use a desktop PC with no USB-C, or you mainly want to game.
products.deal_note: It is 20% off at $279.99 in the Oct 6 Prime sale. Check that your laptop's USB-C port supports video output and charging before you buy.

products.name: LG UltraGear G6
why: PC Gamer lists the UltraGear G6 at $209.99, which is $190 or 48% off its $399.99 list price. That is the biggest percentage cut in this guide. You get a 27-inch 1440p IPS panel with a 300Hz refresh rate and a 1ms response time.

PC Gamer calls the 300Hz speed far more than most players need, but great for the right kind of gamer. If you play fast shooters on a PC that can push very high frame rates, this is a lot of speed for the price.
cons: 300Hz only pays off if your PC reaches very high frame rates
Reported at Best Buy, so check Amazon for the same model
products.best_for: Competitive PC gamers who want 1440p and a very fast screen on a budget.
products.skip_if: your PC or console cannot reach high frame rates, or you want an OLED screen.
products.deal_note: This deal was reported at Best Buy, not Amazon. Compare both stores for the exact model before you buy.

products.name: Samsung Odyssey G50SF
why: The Odyssey G50SF is a 27-inch QD-OLED gaming monitor at 24% off, or $120.99. PC Gamer says an OLED panel with 1440p resolution and 180Hz for this price makes it one of the best-priced QD-OLED monitors around.

OLED gives perfect blacks and a 0.03ms response time, which is hard to match on cheaper LCD screens. The catch is that PC Gamer notes it is not as cheap as it was recently, and it listed a higher $449 price at Best Buy.
pros: OLED picture at a low price
cons: PC Gamer says it was cheaper recently
Best Buy listed it at $449, so prices vary by store
products.best_for: Gamers and movie fans who want the deep blacks and fast response of an OLED without a $600+ price.
products.skip_if: you work with static content for many hours a day, or you want a cheaper LCD.
products.deal_note: The price moves between stores, $379 at Amazon versus $449 at Best Buy on Oct 14. If it drops further closer to Black Friday, that is the one to grab.

faq: Black Friday is Friday, November 27, 2026, and Cyber Monday is Monday, November 30.
Should I buy now or wait for Black Friday?

Some monitor prices in this guide were already low in October's Prime sale. If a monitor you want is at a price you are happy with, buying now is reasonable. Prices can also drop further closer to Black Friday, so check again before the sale.
For work, browsing and streaming, 4K text looks noticeably sharper. For gaming, a 4K screen needs a stronger PC than 1440p, so 1440p is the easier choice if you are on a budget.
Is OLED worth paying extra for?
OLED screens give deeper blacks and very fast response, which gamers and movie fans like. They cost more than most LCD monitors, so decide if the picture quality is worth it for you.
Is the Amazon price the same as Best Buy?
Not always. The LG UltraGear G6 deal was reported at Best Buy, and the Odyssey G50SF was higher at Best Buy than Amazon. Use the Amazon button to compare the current price and exact model.
